notes: Deploy only src/KeptVault.sol:KeptVault on Robinhood Chain (4663). $owner controls the vault; the constructor configures the specified IMD Intake, IMD token, oracle action and signer with panel size 9 and quorum 7. Projects lock tokens behind oracle-checked milestones; kept milestones release to their beneficiary and unproven milestones burn after the grace period. Deployment requires no ETH or initialization calls and creates no token, pool or hook. docs/VERIFICATION.md records the Robinhood fork rehearsal against Intake, IMD and PoolManager.
